notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is structurally catalogued here but blocked at the account level — DARWIN_LDB_TOKEN not set. Same blocker as uk-west-midlands / uk-ellesmere-port.

NET (Nottingham Express Transit) tram: the D1 pack names it as DFT Bus Open Data Service (f-bus~dft~gov~uk, verified live 30 Aug 2026 per the oracle report). Jim pulled the confirmed no-key bulk archive (https://data.bus-data.dft.gov.uk/timetable/download/gtfs-file/all/, itm_all_gtfs.zip, 1.4GB, 632 agencies) fresh on 31 Aug 2026 to fill the intermediate-stop-order gap the pack flagged — Nottingham Express Transit / NET does NOT appear as an agency anywhere in that archive (Manchester Metrolink, West Midlands Metro, Edinburgh Trams, Blackpool Tram, South Yorkshire Supertram, London Tramlink, SPT Subway, and several heritage railways all do). This contradicts the pack's 'verified live' note for NET's GTFS — the 200 response the oracle report saw was almost certainly just the bulk-zip endpoint responding at all, not confirmation NET's data is inside it. Filed as a genuine feed-verification gap for Luke/Nico to re-check, not guessed around here.

Because of the above, NET's intermediate stop order remains unconfirmed (still termini-only, exactly as the D1 pack left it) and no NET board can be built — fetchNetStopBoard() in lib/providers/east-midlands.js throws rather than fabricating a schedule.

Only the printed names the oracle report actually gives are catalogued below (Hucknall, Nottingham Station, Toton Lane, Phoenix Park). No 'city centre' entry — the pack itself never lists it in a 'stations' array, only as loose prose describing Line 2's routing; per direction-model-memo.md it is an unconfirmed placeholder, not a station name, so it is not shipped here.

Renamed 7 Sep 2026: 'Beeston/Chilwell' was never a stop name — it is NET's own label for the Line 1 branch. The real terminus is Toton Lane (in Chilwell, NaPTAN ATCO 9400ZZNOTOT, StopType MET); Beeston's own main stop (Beeston Centre) is a separate, uncatalogued intermediate stop per the termini-only rule. See docs/jim-brief-net-toton-lane-and-stockport-tram.md.

NET stop lat/lng superseded 7 Sep 2026 (uk-catalog-geocode): NaPTAN carries confirmed stop-level coordinates for NET tram stops (StopType TMU/MET, ATCO prefix 3390ZZNO/9400ZZNO) independent of the GTFS-feed-verification gap noted above — that gap is about the real-time/schedule feed, not the stop registry. 4 of 4 stops matched once 'Beeston/Chilwell' was corrected to Toton Lane (NaPTAN ATCO 9400ZZNOTOT, 'Toton Lane Tram Stop', StopType MET) 7 Sep 2026 — the original ambiguity was against the wrong candidate name, not a real NaPTAN gap.

Tamworth (TAM) is deliberately NOT in this catalog — genuine shared National Rail platform with West Midlands, flagged as a D2 de-dup boundary for a future West Midlands pack. See notInRegion below and hazard-pack.md H1.

Coordinates: NaPTAN RailReferences (CRS->coords) pulled 2026-09-07; 6/6 rail stations geocoded | NaPTAN StopType TMU/MET (ATCO prefix 3390ZZNO/9400ZZNO, Nottingham Express Transit) pulled 2026-09-07; 4/4 tram/metro stops geocoded — no exceptions (Toton Lane, ATCO 9400ZZNOTOT, matched 7 Sep 2026 once the catalog entry was corrected from the non-stop label 'Beeston/Chilwell')

7 Sep 2026 (docs/jim-brief-no-live-feed-stops-out-of-picker.md): all 4 NET (mode metro) stops flagged liveFeed: false — NetFeedUnconfirmedError means no board can ever be produced, so these stops stay in the catalog (coordinates kept for coverage notes and a future re-enable) but are no longer offered in the station picker or Near me. National Rail (mode train) stops are unaffected.

13 Sep 2026 (UK station fill phase 1, docs/jim-brief-uk-station-fill-phase1.md, docs/uk-station-fill/{source,assignment,unverified}.md): National Rail catalog expanded from 6 to 105 stations — every Darwin-verified station in Nottinghamshire, Derbyshire, Leicestershire, Northamptonshire (including the county's post-2021 unitary authorities, 'North Northamptonshire'/'West Northamptonshire'), Rutland and Lincolnshire not already owned by South Yorkshire, West Midlands, Greater Anglia or Thames Valley, per Tim's rule ('any station with an API is in') and this brief's ownership rule. Tamworth stays excluded — still West Midlands' per docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md section 2 (unchanged by this pass, West Midlands' own catalog touch is separate). Bingham (BIN, Nottinghamshire) is in the candidate dataset but Darwin returns 404 for it (a real, open, EMR-served station — not a closure) — not shipped, see docs/uk-station-fill/unverified.md, flagged for a re-check rather than guessed around. doNotGroup added: Hucknall (National Rail, new) vs Hucknall (NET tram, existing) — same printed name, separate infrastructure/operator, same shape as Nottingham Station's rail/NET pair. Kings Sutton (KGS, West Northamptonshire) is a borderline call — on the Chiltern Banbury/Oxford corridor, geographically closer to Thames Valley's territory, but administratively Northamptonshire and unclaimed by Thames Valley's own pack; added here per the letter of this brief's county rule, flagged in assignment.md.
